summary: The recovered app is usable and scored 40/52, but this is not an independent cold-start result: the implementation trace read the complete prior test-project-go product and the original turn exceeded the 20-minute limit.

recovery.manualHostRecovery: The Host retained an older Bundle for the same manifest id. The app was removed and installed again from the current catalog before runtime verification.

outsideProductEvidence: The agent globbed sibling cold-v1, cold-v2 and cold-v3 projects.
The agent used a Bash tool call to list test-project-go and cold-v3 even though Bash was not in the requested tool set.
The agent read test-project-go package.json and 21 complete product source files covering the app shell, state, screens, forms, charts, storage, migration and sample data.
The agent described test-project-go in visible reasoning as the proven-working implementation of this exact product.

sourceSimilarity.interpretation: No whole file is byte-identical, but the exact-line overlap and trace prove extensive adaptation of prior business source.

items.reason: Goal data includes name, unit, total, deadline, color, obstacle and contingency plan.
Records append without date uniqueness constraints and the repaired local uid combines time, a monotonic counter and randomness.
A slug-namespaced AsyncStorage key hydrates before writes, seeds only on null storage and saves every reducer mutation; force-stop/reopen persistence passed.
The remaining-over-inclusive-days calculation is correct, but the always-mounted CheckInForm initializes its amount only once and does not refresh the prefill for later goals or openings.
Progress uses recorded amount and forecast uses exactly the prior seven days, requires three distinct record dates and compares projected finish with the deadline.
The streak walks backward, assigns each week's nearest miss as the rest day, counts rest dates as streak days and never respects goal.createdAt.

Yesterday status distinguishes first and second weekly misses and computes overdue days, but it inherits the missing creation boundary and the seed does not visibly demonstrate the yellow first-miss state.
Top/bottom create, edit, confirmed delete, check-in and adjust-plan exits exist, but GoalForm state never resynchronizes when an edit target or modal opening changes.
Amount, optional minutes and six-day backfill controls exist, but amount/date/minutes persist incorrectly across openings because CheckInForm is always mounted without a reset effect.
Goal cards show progress, streak, remaining amount, forecast/deadline status and obstacle/plan content.
Expanded goal cards contain an SVG progress ring, three metrics, plan content and ten latest deletable records.
A single fourteen-day multi-goal inline-SVG stacked chart sums only records with minutes.
Weeks, record days and minutes use the same Monday-Sunday basis, but the top amount and amount WoW sum incompatible units.
Previous/next week navigation exists and all four reflection fields persist through an 800 ms debounce.
Generated text includes comparisons, per-goal detail and all reflections, but its headline amount and WoW retain the mixed-unit error.

Sharing, document picking, migration and valid empty arrays are present, but overwrite confirmation happens before file selection/validation and migrateState accepts malformed objects as destructive empty state.
Sample clearing and exact-phrase clear-all are separate requested confirmations.
The home-screen paragraph conveys the three actions: long-press the desktop, choose the add/card action and locate/add this app.
Three labeled samples, 36 records, backfill, plans and consecutive misses exist, but both visible missed goals are red/rolled and no yellow rest example is exercised.
The 36-record sample makes the backup banner reachable and its CTA invokes exportState directly.
The recovered desktop UI has a coherent cold white/purple/success/danger/amber hierarchy and no starter residue, but the actual gradient is only a three-pixel top strip.
Production icons, ring and stacked chart are local react-native-svg primitives with no emoji, text-glyph icon or external icon package.
Crossing goal completion activates a three-second Animated confetti overlay.
Logical-width phone, tablet and desktop branches use bottom, top and fixed-left navigation; desktop cards wrap into real columns in the shared horizontal frame.
The final repaired source passes all deterministic gates and current-bundle launch, but the automatic closed loop first accepted a crash overlay and then reopened a stale same-id Bundle.
Restoring samples changed an exact product value from empty state to 36 records and the same value survived force-stop/reopen under strict current-project identity.

selectionDecision.reason: Iteration 4's final artifact scores slightly above Cold 2, but its source-boundary violation and deadline failure disqualify it from cold-start comparison. Cold 2 remains the valid orchestration baseline.
